direct_drug_outcomes.maturation_denominator_limit: PanelA printed percentages are not reconstructible as pooled integer successes over its repeated caption Ns. Different denominators/aggregation are possible but unreported; no true GVinput counts inferred.
direct_drug_outcomes.Fig7B_arithmetic_check: Category percentages are compatible with integer counts at caption N; raw per-oocyte data not supplied or independently reconstructed.
direct_drug_outcomes.assay: Chromosome spreading,Giemsa staining,chromosome-pair counting and PSSCclassification; not selected-targetFISH
direct_drug_outcomes.boundary: Direct chromosome-category fidelity endpoint, no proof that every numerical aneuploidy class or subchromosomal abnormality is prevented.
direct_drug_outcomes.replication: Figure7 independent culture/biological replicate and maternal Ns unspecified in readMethods; western-blot triplicates cannot be transferred.
